T: Do the same thing as last time. Snacks included.
D: Schmidt and Jenko go undercover at college to find who is supplying a new drug.
P: Serve the crab when the crab people gag kicks in.
S: Golden crab cakes with lemon and tartare, a tribute to the crab people. Mix 400g crab meat, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs.
Sticky barbecue wings for the frat house. Bake 1.2kg wings at 220C for 45 minutes and toss in 200ml barbecue sauce.
M: Grilled fish tacos with lime and salsa, spring break food. Grill 600g white fish with chilli and lime, flake into 12 tortillas with cabbage, salsa and lime.
W: Giant chocolate chip cookies. Beat 125g butter and 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, 200g flour and 150g chocolate chips.
K: Tequila, lime and triple sec over ice. Limeade for the kids.

s.how: Mix 400g crab meat, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 1 egg and 60g breadcrumbs. Shape 12 cakes and pan-fry 3 minutes a side. Serve with lemon and tartare.
Bake 1.2kg wings at 220C for 45 minutes and toss in 200ml barbecue sauce. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Grill 600g white fish with chilli and lime, flake into 12 tortillas with cabbage, salsa and lime. Bring it to the middle of the table so everyone helps themselves.

w.how: Beat 125g butter and 150g brown sugar, add 1 egg, 200g flour and 150g chocolate chips. Bake 8 big cookies at 180C for 13 minutes.

d.how: Shake 45ml tequila, 30ml lime and 15ml triple sec with ice for each glass and pour over ice. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
